name: Elastigoose
look: a goose of glossy yellow rubber with a long, long neck, a huge orange bill honking wide open over a purple tongue, broad white wings and long orange legs with webbed feet
entry: Its neck stretches like rubber, letting it snatch food from the riverbed or honk right in a foe's face from far away. Its honk is so loud it can be heard three valleys over.
how: Wild: uncommon on rivers, ponds and swamps.
